long_description:
It’s time to BOOGIE! 💗

Join us Sunday, October 25 for an afternoon of dancing, movement and fun in support of breast cancer awareness.

We’ll be moving through Boogie Back in Time, Zumba, Bollywood, African Dance and House Party Dance, plus Planks for Pink — an instructor-led challenge to see how long you can hold your plank!

Bring a friend, wear your pink and come dance with us! 💃 

 https://operations.daxko.com/programs/redirector.aspx?cid=5244&pid=28940&sid=524610
